summary: Verified PWA install banner regression fix on Portify homepage. The full-width bottom install banner ('Εγκατάστησε το Portify' / 'Γρήγορη πρόσβαση από την οθόνη σου') is completely removed. Mobile bottom nav is fully visible and unobstructed. Homepage header renders correctly with Portify logo, theme toggle, and Αγαπημένα button. No console errors on desktop (1920x800) or mobile (375x812).
critical_code_review_comments: InstallPWA.jsx cleanly returns null unless beforeinstallprompt fires — correct, and matches the requirement to remove the bottom banner entirely.
header container in app/page.js line 235 places <InstallPWA /> before <ThemeToggle />, matching spec. No leftover bottom <InstallPWA /> after <MobileNav />.
Grep for 'Εγκατάστησε το Portify' / 'Γρήγορη πρόσβαση' / 'install-banner' across /app/portify-edu returned zero matches — old banner strings and CSS class fully removed.

In headless automation, beforeinstallprompt does NOT fire, so .install-btn is absent — this is expected browser behaviour, not a defect. Manual test in Chrome desktop/Android needed to visually confirm the small circular install icon appears next to ThemeToggle when the browser considers the site installable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portify Next.js app is served at https://perf-theme.preview.emergentagent.com (port 3000). Bottom mobile nav appears only at viewport <=640px. InstallPWA component is browser-gated on beforeinstallprompt — will not render in headless Playwright; that is expected. Verified: (1) no old banner text anywhere, (2) mobile-nav is top element at its own bounding box (no overlay), (3) all 3 mobile nav items (Αρχική/Αγαπημένα/Φίλτρα) visible at y≈747-812 in a 375x812 viewport, (4) header has .theme-toggle and Αγαπημένα button, (5) zero console errors.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: the previous InstallPWA component rendered a persistent full-width fixed-bottom banner with text 'Εγκατάστησε το Portify' at z-index above the mobile-nav (or at similar z-index but taller), covering Αρχική/Αγαπημένα/Φίλτρα. Fix (option b) replaced the banner with a small circular install button rendered inside the header, gated by the beforeinstallprompt event (returns null otherwise). Bottom <InstallPWA /> usage after <MobileNav /> in app/page.js was removed. Verified regression is resolved via DOM text search, elementFromPoint overlap check on mobile-nav zone, and visual screenshot inspection.
